sections.heading: 2. Not financial advice

Nothing in the app is investment, credit, insurance, tax or legal advice, and it is not a recommendation to buy or sell any product. Please consult a qualified professional before making major financial decisions.
Estimates such as safe to spend, forecasts, goal projections and scores depend on your data and on assumptions. They may be wrong. Mathi may make mistakes, so check important figures yourself.

sections.heading: 3. No money movement
body: Valam is a record keeping and planning tool. It does not hold, transfer or invest your money, and it does not connect to your bank to make payments. Drafts prepared by Mathi are saved only when you confirm them.
